text: In the German Autumn of 1977, [Susie Bannion, an American from a Mennonite family in Ohio|who_suffers|newcomers and travellers], is admitted to the Markos Dance Academy in West Berlin. The school is reeling from the disappearance of Patricia, who told her psychotherapist Josef Klemperer that [the academy is run by a coven of witches|threat|witchcraft and cursed things]. As Susie rises to lead the piece Volk, her aggressive dance [ravages the body of a student trapped in a mirrored room|images|mirrors and glass], and the matrons hold [an election for the coven's new leader|wants|power over others].
